_doc: School addendum Section 2 - FEATURE TTL REGISTRY. Every feature block declares its maximum staleness in minutes. At HARVEST time the asof of every block is the row's signal_ts_utc (sensors compute at scan time; no separate stamp needed, no stale substitution exists). At DECISION time (Council/gate-mode) a value older than its TTL becomes MISSING and flows through the model's native missing-data path - never substituted. Quotes/spreads: current cycle only. Changing any TTL is a logged trial at a Sunday boundary.
decision_rule: age_minutes = (decision_ts - asof_ts)/60000; if age_minutes > ttl_minutes[block] then every feature in that block scores as MISSING (NaN) for that decision. Component failure (no quote at all, no probability produced, latency budget exceeded) is a VETO instead - see the canonical missing-data rules.
